newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to pick Chesf, Eletronorte selloff advisors.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to pick Chesf, Eletronorte selloff advisors.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it prequalified six consortia to bid on contracts to advise in the selloff of federal power holding Eletrobras' generating units Eletronorte and Chesf.

In a statement, BNDES said it will open technical proposals July 3 but did not set a date to announce the winners of an A service contract to prepare a financial study and B service contract to design a privatization model.
Geracao e Desenvolvimento, a group led by Capitaltec S.A. consultants, and a consortium led by Banco Interatlantico S.A. are prequalified to bid on the A service contract, it said.
Five groups, it said, won the right to bid on the B service contract top prepare the selloff model. They are:
* A consortium led by Deutsche Bank S.A., including Morgan Grenfell, Credit Suisse, local bank Banco Fator and others;
* A group led by local bank Banco Graphus S.A. and including Kleinwort Benson, Robert Fleming and others;
* A consortium led by local bank Bozano, Simonsen, and including Barclays Bank, Lehman and others;
* Association Enerbras, led by Projeta Consultoria Financeira S.A. Ltda and including N.M. Rothschild, Merrill Lynch, IUtau Bankers, Coopers & Lybrand and others;
The BNDES also said two consortia hoping to land the A contract and one vying for the B contract were disqualified.
No date has been set for the privatization of Eletrobras units, but the selloff is expected to begin early in 1998 with the auctions of the holding's Furnas and Eletrosul generating units.
"There's really no date set for Chesf and Eletronorte, but maybe it will be in 1998," a Mines and Energy Ministry spokeswoman said.
